no_p0_note: No production-blocking P0 found: the current package installer (scripts/install_synapse_package.py) works end-to-end and delivers a working panel, so no single defect blocks all fresh users. install.py defects are P1 because the primary path still succeeds.

findings.claim: install.py is H22-blind: _detect_houdini_prefs() searches only Houdini majors [21,20,19], never 22; on an H22-only machine (target H22.0.400) it returns None and exits 1. README.md:247 blesses install.py as install step 2.

install.py is OneDrive-blind: Windows prefs search uses os.path.join(home, Documents) with no OneDrive-redirect branch; the current package installer handles it (install_synapse_package.py:96-108). Two installers disagree on prefs resolution.

README manual-install doc path is OneDrive-blind: README.md:245 and :264 say the package lives at Documents/houdini22.0/...; on an OneDrive-redirected seat the real dir is OneDrive/Documents/houdini22.0/..., so a hand-install writes where H22 never scans and the panel silently never appears.

First-run failure is silent-absence with no in-Houdini feedback (README.md:298, :328): a mis-encoded/mis-keyworded package makes import synapse succeed and the panel simply never appear. Only out-of-band CLI diagnostics exist.

Install step-count inconsistency: Install is titled Four steps (Clone/Package/Verify/Doctor) but README.md:247 also tells the user to run install.py for shelf/panel/icons — never a numbered step. Steps and prose disagree on whether install.py is required.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is a hard first-run requirement but not a numbered install step (README Install lists Clone/Package/Verify/Doctor). Surfaces only as a --verify FAIL row (install_synapse_package.py:201) and at first prompt; every fresh artist hits the missing-key error.

No artist-facing Operator's Card: all six Operator's-Card/CARD docs are developer/harness-facing (blackbox, latency-relay, render-freeze, rsi-closure, sprint_freeze, RELEASE_CARD). Artist has quickstart.md but no consolidated card.

HALT can give a FALSE confirmation: _on_emergency_halt posts 'Emergency halt triggered.' unconditionally (chat_panel.py:1024) but only sends the command if self._bridge.connected (:1025). Bridge-down => success reported, no halt sent. Safety-control trust defect.

No in-panel render-progress or render-Stop affordance: connection bar exposes only HALT (chat_panel.py:646-651) and Connect. Renders run via chat->MCP; per README.md:148 emergency halt walks /obj only and does NOT kill background renders. Compounds documented render-freeze risk (README.md:124-138).
install.py multi-build ambiguity: returns candidates[0] (newest) by a fixed 21->20->19 order across five builds, no warning multiple exist, no way to know which was chosen.
Installer version drift: install.py prints Installing Synapse v1.0.0 (_VERSION=1.0.0, used at :141) while product is v5.51.0.
BOM trap is manual-path only: README.md:284 warns PowerShell Set-Content -Encoding utf8 writes a BOM Houdini rejects silently; the automated installer is BOM-safe (install_synapse_package.py:129).

Key-location guidance conflict: installer verify (install_synapse_package.py:407) + quickstart (~:43) say the key goes in <repo>/.env; the panel runtime error (anthropic_provider.py:160) says set it SYSTEM-level via setx and never mentions .env. Runtime error is the lone outlier.

Doc drift: quickstart.md:5 links to the README install via anchor #-install--5-minutes, but the README heading is ## Install (anchor #install; jump-nav uses #install at README.md:49). Link will not resolve.

Connection feedback: bar defaults to red _ERROR_COLOR 'Disconnected' (chat_panel.py:632-641); onActivateInterface auto-starts the bridge (:262-267) but posts no Connecting... feedback, unlike the manual Connect button (:683-691). Red resting state misreads as a fault for in-process chat. (Hard errors ARE surfaced to chat via _on_connection_error :946-948.)

Shelf tool error dialogs surface raw exceptions: each synapse.shelf tool does hou.ui.displayMessage('Synapse ... error: {}'.format(e), severity=Error), bypassing the panel's plain-English error_translator.py.

positives.note: Robust installer: OneDrive-aware, globs houdini2* (finds H22), installs all builds, flags the installed-build-not-wired drop-day trap (check_package_file :299-348).
Exemplary missing-key error: exact setx command, warns Windows terminal-scoped set won't inherit, offers hou.secure alternative. Model for the error-language pass.
Strong artist operator doc: explicit success signatures, failure branches, and the crucial in-process (no bridge for normal chat) clarification. Docs gap is a consolidated card, not absence.

Strong plain-English error layer (VEX/cook/render -> explanation + suggested fix). The model to route shelf + other raw-exception surfaces through. Also run_doctor(handler=None) at doctor.py:981 is standalone-capable, so recovery isn't hard-blocked by a down bridge.
